It scans cells left of every door instead of the fixed cell in front of the door on the start side, and its nested conditionals/`else` expression make the semantics unreliable; per the grounding, the ball starts at (dx - 1, dy) for the single door at (dx, dy), so it must return false only when a ball sits on that specific cell (a carried ball counts as moved, since it is not on the grid).
